name: vlm_vqa_caption
description: Visual Question Answering / captioning using a real pretrained vision-language model (BLIP, via transformers). Base checkpoint is trained on natural photos, not remote sensing, so answers about overhead/sensor-specific content are out-of-distribution guesses, not measurements, UNLESS a LoRA adapter has been trained (see training/finetune_vqa_lora.py) and AETHERIS_VLM_LORA_PATH points at it -- none ships by default. Requires the optional 'vlm' extra (torch + transformers); refuses via analysis_unavailable if unavailable.

image_path.description: Path to the input satellite image (GeoTIFF, PNG, or JPEG)

question.description: Natural language question about the image, or 'caption' for a descriptive caption

modality.description: Sensor modality of the input image (used only for labeling the answer)

answer.description: Natural language answer or caption from the VLM

raw_confidence.description: Mean top-token generation probability [0,1], from the model's own softmax
